custom_fields.name: BRD Document Link
custom_fields.description: Link to approved Business Requirements Document (Google Docs or Confluence)
custom_fields.validation: Must be a valid URL to Google Docs or Confluence

custom_fields.name: BRD Owner
custom_fields.description: Person responsible for creating the BRD

custom_fields.name: BRD Approved Date
custom_fields.description: Date when BRD was approved by stakeholders

custom_fields.name: Stakeholder List
custom_fields.description: RACI stakeholders who need to approve this work

custom_fields.name: Epic Link
custom_fields.description: Link to parent Epic for program-level tracking
custom_fields.note: This is a built-in JIRA field - just enable it in Field Configuration

setup_instructions.step_1: Go to JIRA Settings (⚙️) → Issues → Custom fields
setup_instructions.step_3: For each field above, select the appropriate type and configure options
setup_instructions.step_4: Add the field to your project's Field Configuration
setup_instructions.step_5: Associate fields with appropriate screens (Create, Edit, View)
